faq_heading: Homes near Rosemary Heights Elementary: your questions answered

faq.q: Are the homes on this page in the Rosemary Heights Elementary catchment?
faq.a: Not necessarily. The search finds homes whose listing names the school, and the sold prices are measured by distance. Surrey School District sets the catchment and shows it on a map only on its website, so confirm the exact address with the district before you offer.

faq.q: How does the Rosemary Heights Elementary home search find homes?
faq.a: By name: a listing shows up when its description mentions Rosemary Heights Elementary. Ask Jared to watch for nearby homes that leave the school out.

faq.q: How much do homes near Rosemary Heights Elementary sell for?
faq.a: Within 1 km of the school, 139 homes sold between November 1, 2025 and October 31, 2026. Medians were houses $1,840,000, townhomes $790,000, condos $557,500. A median is the middle price and is shown where at least 5 homes sold.

faq.q: How fast do homes sell near Rosemary Heights Elementary?
faq.a: Near Rosemary Heights Elementary (1 km), homes took a median 23 days to sell and closed at 96.8% of the list price, with 4% over asking, across 139 sales.

faq.q: Which schools are closest to Rosemary Heights Elementary?
faq.a: In a straight line, the closest schools in the provincial list are Morgan Elementary (0.5 km south-east), Sunnyside Elementary (1.7 km south-east) and Southridge School (2.2 km south-east).

Rosemary Heights Elementary is an elementary school in Surrey (Surrey School District), at 15516 36 Ave. It teaches grades K to 7.
Below are the homes currently for sale whose listing mentions Rosemary Heights Elementary, followed by what homes within 1 km of the school sold for.
How the Rosemary Heights Elementary search works

MLS® listings are not tagged by school. This search finds houses, townhomes and condos whose description names Rosemary Heights Elementary, so a home close to the school whose listing leaves the name out will not appear, and a listing that names the school can sit farther than 1 km away. Use the sold prices below for the distance-based picture, and ask Jared to watch for homes near the school that the search misses.
What homes within 1 km of Rosemary Heights Elementary sold for
Between November 1, 2025 and October 31, 2026, 139 homes sold within 1 km of Rosemary Heights Elementary: 34 houses, 51 townhomes and 54 condos. The largest group was condos, at a median of $557,500.

blocks.text: Schools within 3 km of Rosemary Heights Elementary

6 schools in the provincial school list sit within 3 km of Rosemary Heights Elementary in a straight line (4 elementary, 2 other; 3 independent). The closest is Morgan Elementary, 0.5 km away, and the farthest on this list is White Rock Christian Academy, 2.7 km away. By type, the nearest elementary school is Morgan Elementary (0.5 km); the nearest independent school is Southridge School (2.2 km). Other elementary schools close by: Morgan Elementary (0.5 km south-east), Sunnyside Elementary (1.7 km south-east), Semiahmoo Trail Elementary (2.2 km south-west), Star of the Sea (2.6 km south). The nearest school teaching the same grades (K-7) is Morgan Elementary, 0.5 km south-east of Rosemary Heights Elementary.
